---
name: jordan-approves-plans-before-execution
description: Jordan approves a plan explicitly before any execution starts; a correction is direction, not a go-ahead
metadata:
  type: feedback
---

Jordan approves plans explicitly. A correction to a plan is direction
for the next revision, not permission to start.

**Why:** On 2030-01-03 an agent started to execute after Jordan corrected
one step. Jordan interrupted: "Fix the plan first."

**How to apply:** After a correction, revise the plan and ask again.
Start only on a clear "go ahead". Related: [[widget-api-migration]].
